The '''Green Jedi Enclave''' was a heavily fortified ziggurat structure<ref name="Force and Destiny">[[Star Wars: Force and Destiny Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Force and Destiny'' Core Rulebook]]</ref> in [[Coronet City/Legends|Coronet City]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]].

==History==
===Great Galactic Wars===
The Enclave in Coronet City was headquarters of the [[Corellian Jedi|Green Jedi]] on Corellia, a pacifist sect of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] that operated outside of the edicts of the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. An [[Green Jedi Council|administrative council]] oversaw Jedi operations on the planet and maintained their meeting chambers within the Enclave.<ref name="The Old Republic" /> Following the [[Great Galactic War]] and the [[Sacking of Coruscant|sacking]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] by the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], the facility was fortified with powerful [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] that were fueled by internal reactors that protected the structure from attack.<ref name="TORC">{{TORcite|type=codex|Green Jedi Enclave}}</ref>

During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] the Sith Empire invaded Corellia and made the Green Jedi Enclave its top priority target, but initial attempts at destroying it utterly failed. The site's shields protected the structure from the first assault as intended and allowed the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] inhabitants to set up offensive cannons. This led to a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] warship that was sent to destroy the Enclave being shot to pieces over the sector. A large part of the vessel crashed into the Enclave, however this failed to inflict heavy casualties or even substantially weaken the structure. As a result, the Green Jedi Enclave became a constant reminder of the failure of the Empire despite a nearly flawless invasion of the planet.<ref name="TORC" /> The Enclave's leader, [[Arfan Ramos]], quickly allied with the resistance and the group began aiding their fellow Corellians in the fight against the Empire.<ref name="The Old Republic" />

[[File:Green_Jedi_on_Corellia.jpg|thumb|left|260px|Green Jedi defend the Enclave against an attack]]
As the fighting intensified, [[Battlemaster/Legends|Jedi Battlemaster]] [[Jun Seros]] attempted to reinforce the Enclave by staging the Jedi under his command in the [[Green Gardens]] in the facility's forecourt, but he was slain by a skilled [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]]. After the loss of Seros, [[Darth Decimus]] personally led an elite force of Sith and Imperial operatives in an assault against the Enclave. After his agents defeated a team of Republic commandos and the Jedi Master [[Bedoch]] in the [[Republic Foundation Museum]] in order to recover the Enclave's access codes, Decimus's forces and a team of Imperial Guards under General [[Hesker]]'s leadership stormed the structure and fought a brutal battle against the army of Green Jedi within. Within the Enclave, the Sith forces killed Master Arfan Ramos and the other members of the [[Green Jedi Council]] in a battle in the Council's chamber, and Decimus's agents eliminated [[Darbin Sull]] since the man had outlived his usefulness. After taking the Green Jedi enclave, the Imperials established a garrison in the structure, but the Republic employed stealth troopers in an attempt to drive out the invaders. The Imperial tech specialist [[Shon (soldier)|Shon]] determined that the Republic was utilizing an incredibly advanced [[Cloaking device/Legends|cloaking technology]], but managed to modify a [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field generator]] to disrupt other fields. As a result, Imperial forces were able to strip the stealth troopers' advantages, leveling the playing field and allowing the more numerous Imperials to secure their control of the enclave.<ref name="Nowhere to Hide">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Nowhere To Hide|Corellia}}</ref>

===Rise of the Galactic Empire===
During the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Empire established an Imperial liaison building for [[Corellian Security Force]] atop the remains of the old enclave.<ref name="Force and Destiny" />
